_about: Ethanol (1) + Tetrahydrofuran (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: L. Cao, P. Liu, B. Wang, Q. Li, Vapor-liquid equilibria for tetrahydrofuran + ethanol system containing three different ionic liquids at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 372 (2014) 49-55
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1, 2. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0057. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
